title: Novel C-3 and C-20 derived analogs of betulinic acid as potent cytotoxic agents: design, synthesis, in vitro and in silico studies
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,15164-15177
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01038A, Paper

Nisar A. Dangroo, Ziad Moussa, Mustafa S. Alluhaibi, Abdulrahman A. Alsimaree, Mohammed B. Hawsawi, Reem I. Alsantali, Jasvinder Singh, Nidhi Gupta, Basavarajaiah S. M., Prashantha Karunakar, J. M. Mir, Manzoor A. Rather, Saleh A. Ahmed
In this report, novel derivatives of betulinic acid were designed and synthesized by targeting the C-3-OH group and C-20 olefinic bond in an endeavour to develop potent antitumor agents.
